newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz H1 gp premiums rose 8.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Allianz H1 gp premiums rose 8.3 pct.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)

NOTE - Full name of the German insurer is Allianz AG Holding, Europe's largest insurance group. In its interim report, Allianz said its group earnings had also improved in the period but was not more specific. The insurer noted that its group premiums rose by 4.9 percent in original currency, and that the 8.3 percent rise was based on exchange rates on June 30. Premium income was additionally boosted by the appreciation of major foreign currencies against the mark, the insurer said.
